content.text: {sceneState.win and 'A004 — YOU WIN!' or 'A004 — Push crates to goals'}
Arrows move  Enter reset  B back

scripts.move:
local s = ctx.sceneState
local nx = s.px + s.dx
local ny = s.py + s.dy
local function isWall(x, y)
    if x < 0 or x > 7 or y < 0 or y > 7 then return true end
    if y == 0 or y == 7 then return true end
    if x == 0 or x == 7 then return true end
    if x == 2 and y == 2 then return true end
    if x == 3 and y == 2 then return true end
    if x == 4 and y == 2 then return true end
    if x == 5 and y == 3 then return true end
    if x == 1 and y == 4 then return true end
    if x == 2 and y == 4 then return true end
    if x == 3 and y == 5 then return true end
    if x == 5 and y == 6 then return true end
    if x == 6 and y == 6 then return true end
    return false
end
local function getCrate(x, y)
    if x == s.c1x and y == s.c1y then return 1 end
    if x == s.c2x and y == s.c2y then return 2 end
    return nil
end
if not isWall(nx, ny) then
    local c = getCrate(nx, ny)
    if c then
        local nnx = nx + s.dx
        local nny = ny + s.dy
        if not isWall(nnx, nny) and not getCrate(nnx, nny) then
            if c == 1 then
                s.c1x = nnx
                s.c1y = nny
            else
                s.c2x = nnx
                s.c2y = nny
            end
            s.px = nx
            s.py = ny
        end
    else
        s.px = nx
        s.py = ny
    end
end
local g1x, g1y = 3, 1
local g2x, g2y = 2, 5
local on1 = (s.c1x == g1x and s.c1y == g1y) or (s.c1x == g2x and s.c1y == g2y)
local on2 = (s.c2x == g1x and s.c2y == g1y) or (s.c2x == g2x and s.c2y == g2y)
s.win = on1 and on2
scripts.render:
local s = ctx.sceneState
local g1x, g1y = 3, 1
local g2x, g2y = 2, 5
local function isWall(x, y)
    if x < 0 or x > 7 or y < 0 or y > 7 then return true end
    if y == 0 or y == 7 then return true end
    if x == 0 or x == 7 then return true end
    if x == 2 and y == 2 then return true end
    if x == 3 and y == 2 then return true end
    if x == 4 and y == 2 then return true end
    if x == 5 and y == 3 then return true end
    if x == 1 and y == 4 then return true end
    if x == 2 and y == 4 then return true end
    if x == 3 and y == 5 then return true end
    if x == 5 and y == 6 then return true end
    if x == 6 and y == 6 then return true end
    return false
end
local lines = {}
for y = 0, 7 do
    local r = ""
    for x = 0, 7 do
        if x == s.px and y == s.py then r = r .. "@"
        elseif (x == s.c1x and y == s.c1y) or (x == s.c2x and y == s.c2y) then r = r .. "O"
        elseif isWall(x, y) then r = r .. "#"
        elseif (x == g1x and y == g1y) or (x == g2x and y == g2y) then r = r .. "."
        else r = r .. " " end
    end
    table.insert(lines, r)
end
s.boardText = table.concat(lines, "\n")
